recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一小群細胞，細胞質深藍、部分可見核旁淡染區，但細胞核呈明顯分葉（花瓣或苜蓿葉狀），這是具多形性（anaplastic）特徵的循環漿細胞，符合漿細胞白血病。
features: Cluster of four large atypical plasma cells in peripheral blood
Markedly lobated, cloverleaf-like nuclei in three cells; one cell with a round eccentric nucleus
Coarse, clumped chromatin; nucleoli not prominent in this field
Moderate to abundant basophilic cytoplasm with paranuclear clearing
Background red cells with rouleaux-like stacking
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of large atypical plasma cells. Three cells have markedly lobated, cloverleaf-like nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin, and one has a round eccentric nucleus; all have moderate to abundant basophilic cytoplasm with paranuclear clearing. The background red cells show focal rouleaux-like stacking. In the setting of circulating plasma cells and a monoclonal IgG lambda protein, findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia with anaplastic (pleomorphic, lobated) plasma cell morphology.

ddx.vs: ATLL flower cells have scant cytoplasm without a hof and are CD4+/CD25+ T cells, whereas these lobated cells have abundant basophilic plasmacytoid cytoplasm.
Monocytes have fine lacy chromatin, folded rather than lobated nuclei, and gray vacuolated cytoplasm without a sharp paranuclear hof.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has blast-like chromatin with prominent central nucleoli, EBV positivity, and often MYC rearrangement, requiring clinical and IHC correlation.
